title: Frozen Axis-Anchored V1 failure attribution for the minimal V2
purpose: Determine whether the sealed axis and relation failures come from loss of five-frame directional fusion and from an unsuitable dense rare-event objective, and decide whether soft circular peaks are sufficient or explicit object-level transport is required.

approval.scope: One immutable Gate-3 CPU-only audit of sealed C07/C08 predictions, Teacher arrays and predecessor summaries; no training, new inference, C09/C10/M-TARE/graph/planner.
approval.confirmation_reference: User instructed continuous autonomous execution and selection of the evidence-optimal method without routine approval prompts.

raw_sources: Sealed C07/C08 five-frame LiDAR dataset and objective relation Teacher.
Sealed Axis-Anchored V1 three-seed development predictions.
Sealed predecessor Peak V2 and Slot-Transport selection summaries.
source.license_or_allowed_use: Local project-generated procedural worlds and objective targets.

worlds.audit_scope: Only 20 frozen development worlds are read: ten C07 and ten C08. C01-C06 enter only through frozen population constants; strict-test worlds are forbidden.

sampling.rule: Read every sealed C07/C08 observation and all valid past-to-current relation cells once; report exact-bin ranking, oracle-count top-k localization at fixed circular radii 0/1/2/4 bins, and positive-vs-empty slice separability.

teacher.source: Objective TNG exit identity transported across same-traversal observation pairs and rasterized into independent persistent/reveal/withdraw channels.
teacher.valid_mask: A relation step is valid only when both observation-level endpoints exist on the same traversal; -1 cells stay masked and no missing relation is imputed.
teacher.planner_consistency_plan: The audit creates no node or edge and calls no planner. Teacher identity is used only for frozen target reconstruction and never enters a model forward pass.

split.historical_pollution_audit: No checkpoint, prediction, threshold, normalization or Teacher is changed. C07 and C08 are both diagnostic development populations; neither authorizes model selection in this audit.
split.selection: None. All radii and metrics are fixed before reading outputs.
split.transfer: No threshold is fitted or transferred.

methods.main: Reproduce formal V1 metrics; inspect frozen source contracts; compare current single-frame axis head against sealed five-frame directional predecessors; compute relation prevalence, effective BCE weights, exact average precision, safe precision-recall envelope, positive-slice AUC and oracle-count circular top-k localization.
methods.baseline: Current Axis-Anchored V1 C07/C08 axis 82.7165/83.0120 degrees and predecessor Peak/Slot axis approximately 5.1-5.8 degrees under the same development populations.
methods.fallback: If frozen joins or source contracts drift, seal system FAIL. If relation scores lack local ranking even with oracle count, require object-centric transport rather than another dense loss; do not train or relax safety metrics.

failure_policy: Do not train, infer, change a checkpoint, tune a threshold, widen the formal task tolerance, read strict-test worlds, or enter graph/planner. Any population, source-hash or prediction join drift stops the run.
retention: Retain summary, per-channel CSV, attribution figures and source, environment, raw log, RUN_STATE and SHA-256 seal. Source predictions/checkpoints remain in their immutable runs.

estimated_cost.compute: CPU-only deterministic attribution over 45,942 frozen observations
